author: ABMN Staff
title: Equities Research Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for May, 13th (ARNC, BBVA, CALL, CBRE, CHTR, CTC.A, CWCO, FDC, LBTYA, NWL)
text:
Equities Research Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Sunday, May 13th:
Arconic (NYSE:ARNC) had its hold rating reaffirmed by analysts at Barclays. Barclays currently has a $20.00 target price on the stock. Get Arconic alerts:
Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria (NYSE:BBVA) was upgraded by analysts at ValuEngine from a sell rating to a hold rating. Magicjack Vocaltec (NASDAQ:CALL) was upgraded by analysts at ValuEngine from a hold rating to a buy rating.
CBRE Group (NYSE:CBRE) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Barclays. The firm currently has a $58.00 price target on the stock.
Charter Communications (NASDAQ:CHTR) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Macquarie.
Canadian Tire (TSE:CTC.A) had its target price reduced by Barclays from C$190.00 to C$186.00.
Consolidated Water (NASDAQ:CWCO) was upgraded by analysts at ValuEngine from a hold rating to a buy rating.
First Data (NYSE:FDC) had its hold rating reiterated by analysts at Nomura. The firm currently has a $18.00 target price on the stock.
Liberty Global (NASDAQ:LBTYA) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Barclays. The firm currently has a $39.00 target price on the stock.
Newell Brands (NYSE:NWL) had its hold rating reissued by analysts at Barclays. The firm currently has a $29.00 target price on the stock.
Quanterix (NASDAQ:QTRX) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at BTIG Research. The firm currently has a $26.00 target price on the stock. The analysts wrote, “Acceleration, and Expanding NT PT:1Q18 revenue growth of +41% exceeded consensus of +33% driven by strength in higher margin consumable and service revenue growth. Pharma/Biotech/CRO segment (46% of revenue) grew +48%, and Academic (46% of revenue) grew +33%. Academic should continue to strengthen with the recent launch of SR-X (1Q represented first full quarter of commercial sales; Asia launch on target for 2Q). While formal guidance for the full year remains unavailable, management is committed to delivering consensus expectations (~50% revenue growth). Looking ahead, QTRX expects to increase its sales force emphasis on the Accelerator business NT leveraging its recently acquired CLIA lab facilities (Aushon tuck-in), and in order to capitalize on the recent regulatory developments increasingly focusing on biomarker incorporation throughout biopharma preclinical/clinical trials.””
Senseonics (NYSEAMERICAN:SENS) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at BTIG Research. They currently have a $5.00 target price on the stock. The analysts wrote, “Await Anticipated FDA Approval; Buy Although we don’t expect a ton of stock movement around this quarter’s SENS report, commentary was upbeat on the OUS market and on the company’s preparation for the anticipated US approval and launch. The $18-$20M revenue guide for 2018 was maintained; we remain above this range as we think this may include some conservatism on the early US launch. It was great to hear that the company may receive approval before the ADA meeting – this mention on timing could push shares higher.””
Synaptics (NASDAQ:SYNA) had its hold rating reiterated by analysts at Rosenblatt Securities. The firm currently has a $48.00 price target on the stock. The analysts wrote, “We think Synaptics will have ASP increases for the LCD model with Chip on Film solution at Apple (AAPL: Buy) during the second half of the year, but we are unsure if most of the incremental ASP growth will pass through to the top- line. Revenue may see some growth at 2nd half of CY2018, along with slight gross margin improvement. The TDDI business, among the android market, faces some pricing pressure in the 2nd half of 2018. We con- tinue to maintain our neutral rating on the stock until we have a better idea about whether Apple will keep the LCD model for the 2nd half of 2019. We raise our price target from $36 to $48, based on FY2019 EPS of $4.73. Be- cause of the uncertainty on Apple’s panel strategy, we value the stock at 10x FY2019 PE.””
Voyager Therapeutics (NASDAQ:VYGR) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at BTIG Research. The analysts wrote, “Before mkt open on Thursday, Voyager released their 1Q18 financial results and update. Management reconfirmed that the first patient in the Phase 2-3 Parkinson’s (PD) studies could be dosed during mid-2018, and further confirmed that posterior delivery will be the preferred approach. The decision to use posterior delivery was based upon improved safety, surgical time, and coverage of the putamen – with first data from the posterior study being presented later in 2Q18. The posterior study dataset will focus on patients with 6-months of follow-up, which will be a small group of patients, as the 8 th patient in the posterior study was recently dosed.
